description: Sheet template definitions for SLD composition. Defines physical paper dimensions, border, title block, content margins, and zone graduations for each supported sheet size. Part of the SLD data layer.

30x42.name: Arch E1 — 30×42 (42in w × 30in h, landscape)
30x42.notes: Standard large-format engineering sheet (Arch E1; V1_0_0 mislabeled this size ARCH D / ANSI D). Zone numbers run right-to-left on top/bottom edges, zone letters bottom-to-top on left/right edges. Drawing area at 96 px/in: x 72-3480, y 72-2808 (3408x2736 px = 35.5x28.5 in).
